translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “In Ayub, luong ane ka bende nitiere ngʼama nyalo dwoki?
Bende nitie kuom jo-malaika minyalo ringo irgi?
Ich wangʼ nego ngʼama ofuwo,
kendo nyiego tieko ngʼama omingʼ.
An awuon aseneno ngʼama ofuwo ka odak e ngima maber,
to apoya nono opo ka ode okwongʼ.
Nyithinde ok nyal yudo konyruok
kendo onge ngʼama chwakgi e od bura.
Joma kech oloyo chamo chamb ngʼat mofuwono,
nyaka mago madongo e kind kuthe,
kendo joma riyo oloyo dwaro yako mwandune.
Nikech richo ok honre ahona kayiem,
kata chandruok bende ok bi kaonge gima omiyo.
To dhano inywolo ei chandruok,
mana kaka pilni mach dhwolore kadhi malo.
“Dine bed ni an in, to dine atero ywakna ne Nyasaye;
kendo keto weche mathaga e nyime.
Otimo gik madongo miwuoro ma rieko dhano ok chopie
honni mage thoth ma ok nyal kwan.
Omiyo koth chue e piny;
kendo omiyo puothe bedo mangʼich.
Joma ni piny otingʼo malo,
kendo ohoyo joma ywak.
Oketho chenro mar joma paro timo timbe mamono
mondo omi gik ma giparogo kik timre.
Omako joma riek gi riekogi giwegi,
kendo gimoro amora ma giparo timo ok timre.
Piny othonegi mudho kata mana ka chiengʼ rieny,
gibagni odiechiengʼ tir mana ka gima en otieno.
Oreso joma odhier e dho tho;
kendo oresogi e lwet joma roteke.
Omiyo joma odhier bedo gi geno,
to joma timbegi mono omiyo lingʼ thi.
“En jahawi ngʼat ma Nyasaye kwero,
omiyo kik icha kum mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
Nimar kokecho kodi mochwadi
to en bende ema ochako othiedho kuonde mohinyorego.
Enoresi ka in e masiche mar auchiel; to adier,
ok enoweyi ichopi e masiche mar abiriyo.
Ka dera omako piny, to obiro resi e tho,
kendo ka lweny gore to obiro resi e dho ligangla.
Enopandi kuom dhok makwongʼi,
kendo ok niluor kethruok mabiro.
Inibed mamor ka masira gi kech nitie
kendo ok niluor le mager mag piny.
Nikech initim winjruok gi kite manie lowo,
kendo le mag bungu nobed kodi gi kwe.
Iningʼe ni hembi oriti maber;
inikwan mwanduni achiel achiel,
kendo ok niyud kaonge moro kuomgi molal.
Inibed kingʼeyo ni nyithindi nobed mangʼeny,
kendo nyikwayi nochal gi lum manie piny.
Inidag amingʼa mitho kapod itegno,
mana ka cham mokaa e kinde mowinjore.
“Wasenono wachni, mwanwangʼo ni en adier.
Omiyo winje kendo iti kode e ngimani.”
